svg.text: K9c WELL — the donor dishwasher's own tub, opened at the top
A bought slim dishwasher stays whole under the deck; the hand loads it from above through a hole cut in its ceiling.
well column 480 mm (K9b 550) · slim 45 cm dishwasher (€270–350)
mouth 400 × 440 cut into the tub ceiling · tub inside ≈ 400 × 500 × 550 [U]
machine part €205 (K9b welded tub €500): cut, collar, gasket, combs, nozzles
final rinse 82 °C / 60 s from the hot store · dried by the extraction fan
FRONT SECTION through the well column (oven above not shown)
SIDE SECTION: the dishwasher door stays shut
pans on edge in bent combs
front service door to the filter
logger on the coldest item checks the 82 °C / 60 s rinse

g.text: 1/6 The lid (the bench) lifts; the hand lowers a dirty pan on edge through the 400 × 440 mouth into a bent comb
2/6 Tools go into the donor's own cutlery basket; the lid closes over the mouth
3/6 Wash: the donor's pump drives its lower arm and two fan-nozzle rows on the old upper-arm feed
4/6 Hot rinse: the hot valve feeds 85 °C water from the store; every item sees 82 °C for 60 s
5/6 Drain; the lid stays ajar and the hob-extraction fan pulls cell air through the well to dry it
6/6 The hand lifts the clean pan out from above — the dishwasher's front door is never opened in use
